item.title: Jeong Seong-ho: "The Responsibility for Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Should Fall on the Ruling Party's Hardliners" (정성호 “보완수사권 폐지 책임, 與강경파가 져야 할 것”)
item.description:
Jeong Seong-ho: "The Responsibility for Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Should Fall on the Ruling Party's Hardliners" (정성호 “보완수사권 폐지 책임, 與강경파가 져야 할 것”)

As a bill to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers is set to pass the National Assembly plenary session led by the Democratic Party of Korea, figures from the ruling party are voicing concerns until the last moment. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho, who has maintained a cautious stance, recently told those around him, "In the end, the responsibility will have to be borne by the hardline lawmakers who pushed this bill." <<> People Power Party lawmaker Kim Tae-gyu revealed a recent conversation with Minister Jeong during the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 28th. Kim stated, "When I mentioned the issue of supplementary investigation powers during my filibuster (on the 21st), Minister Jeong came to me and said 'Well done.' It shows how frustrated he must have been." At the time, while filibustering against the bill to extend the second comprehensive special counsel, Kim had argued, "If you insist on thorough investigations, why are you trying to abolish supplementary investigation powers? If this is the path, you might as well establish a special prosecution office." <<> Minister Jeong is also reported to have said in a recent private meeting with Democratic Party lawmakers on the Legislation committee that "the responsibility for abolishing supplementary investigation powers should fall on the ruling party." President Lee Jae-myung also recently, when handing over the issue of supplementary investigation powers to the ruling party during a press conference, made remarks implying "the ruling party should bear the responsibility." Minister Jeong has previously argued that "abolishing supplementary investigation powers would result in harm to crime victims," advocating for retaining some of these powers and fully reinstating the transfer of all cases. However, the Democratic Party decided to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers, applying the transfer of all cases only to seven major crimes, including child abuse. In response, Minister Jeong publicly expressed his intention to resign before the Legislation committee, saying, "New wine should be put into new wineskins." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, a former Minister of Justice, targeted Minister Jeong on the 30th, saying, "A position is meant to prevent wrongdoing, not to run away from it." <<> Park Chan-un, a professor at Hanyang University Law School and former chair of the advisory committee for the Prime Minister's Prosecution Reform Task Force, also wrote on Facebook the same day, "A few lawmakers huddle in a small room, flipping through documents, and with a few words, the legal order of the country, which has continued for nearly 80 years, changes." He added, "I honestly want to ask (the lawmakers): Aren't you afraid?" He urged, "Even now, the furious sprint must be stopped." Professor Park noted, "For an amendment of this scale, even if dozens of scholars and practitioners researched and debated for years, it wouldn't be easy to reach a conclusion. Going this way leads to catastrophe." <<> Professor Park resigned as chair of the advisory committee for the Prosecution Reform Task Force in March, protesting the Democratic Party's policy to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers. He also attended the Democratic Party's policy general meeting on the 21st as an expert panel member, voicing opposition to abolishing supplementary investigation powers, but his views were not accepted. (검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 법안이 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의 통과를 앞둔 가운데, 여권 인사들이 마지막까지 우려의 목소리를 내고 있다. 신중론을 견지해 온 정성호 법무부 장관은 최근 주변에 “결국 책임은 이 법안을 주도한 강경파 의원들이 져야 할 것”이라고 말했다고 한다.)

item.title: Ruling party completely eliminates supplementary investigation rights of prosecutors (검사 보완수사권 與, 완전히 없앴다)
item.description:
Ruling party completely eliminates supplementary investigation rights of prosecutors (검사 보완수사권 與, 완전히 없앴다)

A revision bill to the Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the supplementary investigation rights of the prosecution was tabled at the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. The People Power Party launched a filibuster (unlimited debate) in the afternoon to block the bill's passage, but the Democratic Party plans to halt the debate through a vote 24 hours later on the 31st, in accordance with the National Assembly Act, and push the bill through by force. (검찰의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안이 30일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의에 상정됐다. 국민의힘은 법안 통과를 막기 위해 이날 오후 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 돌입했지만, 민주당은 국회법에 따라 24시간 후인 31일 표결로 토론을 중단시키고 법안을 강행 처리한다는 계획이다.)

Rep. Kim Seung-won, the Democratic Party’s secretary of the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee, said in his proposal explanation for the bill that day, “(The amendment) is a constitutional safeguard to protect the people from serious illegal investigations and abuse of prosecutorial power.” (국회 법제사법위원회 민주당 간사 김승원 의원은 이날 법안 제안 설명에서 “(개정안은) 중대한 위법 수사와 공소권 남용으로부터 국민을 보호하기 위한 헌법적 안전장치”라고 했다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party opposed it, calling it “a declaration to abandon the rule of law and the safety of the people.” Regarding the Democratic Party’s passage of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment at a subcommittee on legislative review late on the 28th, which added provisions expanding the ‘grounds for court dismissal of prosecution,’ they also claimed it was “a political backroom deal between President Lee Jae-myung, who seeks to erase criminal trials, and hardliners in the Democratic Party, who aim to abolish the prosecution.” (반면 국민의힘은 “법치주의와 국민의 안전을 포기하겠다는 선언”이라고 반발했다. 민주당이 지난 28일 밤 법안심사1소위에서 ‘법원의 공소기각 사유’를 확대하는 내용을 추가해 형소법 개정안을 통과시킨 데 대해서도 “범죄 재판을 지우려는 이재명 대통령과 검찰을 없애려는 민주당 강경파의 정치적 이면 계약”이라고 했다.)

After holding a protest rally at the main building of the National Assembly that afternoon, lawmakers of the People Power Party filed for a filibuster once the Criminal Procedure Act amendment was tabled at the plenary session, and began an unlimited debate starting with six-term lawmaker Joo Ho-young. (국민의힘 의원들은 이날 오후 국회 본청에서 규탄 대회를 연 뒤 본회의에서 형소법 개정안이 상정되자 필리버스터를 신청하고 6선의 주호영 의원을 시작으로 무제한 토론에 들어갔다.)

Following the handling of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, the Democratic Party plans to table a ‘fast-track (expedited processing agenda) deadline reduction bill’. It aims to shorten the current fast-track review period, which takes up to 330 days—‘180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days at the plenary session’—to ‘60 days in standing committees, 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and tabling at the first plenary session after submission to the plenary’. However, as the term of the extraordinary session ends at midnight on July 31, the vote is expected to take place at the first plenary session of the August extraordinary session. National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik recently suggested a cautious approach to the Democratic Party leadership, saying, “National Assembly operations require consensus between the ruling and opposition parties,” but the party leadership is reported to have maintained its stance of pushing the bill through. (민주당은 형소법 개정안 처리 이후엔 ‘패스트트랙(신속 처리 안건) 기한 단축법’을 상정할 예정이다. ‘상임위원회 180일, 법제사법위원회 90일, 본회의 60일’ 등 최장 330일이 걸리는 현행 패스트트랙 심사 기간을 ‘상임위 60일, 법사위 30일, 본회의 부의 후 첫 본회의 상정’으로 줄인다는 내용이다. 다만 7월 31일 자정 임시국회 회기가 종료되는 만큼 표결은 8월 임시국회 첫 본회의에서 이뤄질 전망이다. 조정식 국회의장은 최근 민주당 지도부에 “국회 운영은 여야 합의가 중요하다”는 신중론을 제시했지만, 당 지도부는 강행 처리 방침을 밝힌 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: The US, Embarking on 'Operation to Remove Syngman Rhee,' Invites Paik Sun-yup to Washington (‘이승만 제거 작전’ 돌입한 미국, 백선엽을 워싱턴으로 초청하다)
item.description:
As is well known, the armistice agreement that marked the end of the Korean War was signed on July 27, 1953. Ahead of this monumental turning point, the situation on the Korean Peninsula was in great turmoil. Even in the face of dramatic changes in the circumstances, President Syngman Rhee remained steadfast as a mountain. (잘 알려진 대로 6.25전쟁의 막바지인 휴전협정 조인일은 1953년 7월 27일이다. 그 대단한 전환(轉換)을 앞두고 한반도의 정세는 크게 요동치고 있었다. 이승만 대통령은 드라마틱한 정세의 커다란 변화 앞에서도 커다란 산(山)처럼 꿋꿋함을 이어가고 있었다.)

He showed no signs of backing down from his position, insisting, "How can there be an armistice when there are a million Chinese troops in the north?" Nevertheless, he could not afford to be in constant conflict with the US military, which held the initiative in the war on the peninsula. The United States was also putting all its efforts into the major transition of the armistice in Korea. (그는 “북쪽에 중공군 100만명이 있는데 무슨 휴전이냐”는 입장에서 조금도 물러설 기세가 없었다. 그래도 한반도에서 전쟁 주도권을 쥔 미군과 갈등만을 거듭할 수는 없는 상황이었다. 미국 또한 한반도 휴전이라는 큰 전환점을 두고 총력을 모두 기울이고 있었다.)

Army Chief of Staff Paik Sun-yup found himself caught in the middle. He could not defy the will of President Syngman Rhee, the commander-in-chief, but he also had to remain attentive in negotiations with the US military, which held decisive authority over South Korea's security. It was in this context, in early May 1953, that he received an invitation letter from General Lawton Collins, the US Army Chief of Staff. The request was for him to come to the United States to undergo top-level command training. (백선엽 육군참모총장은 그 가운데 낀 입장이었다. 통수권자인 이승만 대통령의 뜻을 거스를 수 없었지만, 대한민국 안보의 결정적 권한을 쥔 미군과 교섭에도 변함없이 신경을 써야 하는 처지였다. 그러던 1953년 5월 초순이었다. 미 육군참모총장 로튼 콜린스 장군으로부터 초청 서한이 왔다. 미국에 와서 최고 지휘관 교육을 이수해 달라는 요청이었다.)

Around the time when the final conflict between President Syngman Rhee and the US administration was escalating ahead of the armistice, Paik Sun-yup, unable to refuse this proposal from the US military, embarked on a journey to the US in mid-May of that year. The itinerary involved flying by military aircraft to Japan, then via Honolulu, Hawaii, to San Francisco, USA. The schedule entailed a total of two days of flying from Japan. Thus, Paik Sun-yup crossed the Pacific on his first visit to the United States. (휴전을 앞두고 이승만 대통령과 미 행정부 사이의 막바지 갈등이 번지던 무렵이었으나, 미군의 이 제안 또한 함부로 거절할 수 없었던 백선엽은 그해 5월 중순 방미의 여정에 오른다. 군용기 편으로 일본에 건너가서 하와이 호놀룰루를 거쳐 미국 샌프란시스코에 닿는 일정이었다. 일본에서 출발해 모두 이틀 동안 비행하는 스케줄이었다. 그렇게 백선엽은 태평양을 건너 미국 첫 방문길에 올랐다.)

Details about 'Operation Eveready' are fairly well-known. This was the name of a plan devised by the US Army ahead of the 1953 armistice. Its aim was to remove President Syngman Rhee from power, thereby eliminating an obstacle to the peace agreement. It was one of the contingency plans prepared by the US military as the interests of President Syngman Rhee, who repeatedly opposed the US-led armistice by advocating for a "unilateral northward advance by the Korean military," clashed with the US administration. Amidst this ongoing deliberation by the US military, the visit of South Korean Army Chief of Staff Paik Sun-yup emerged. (‘상비 작전(Operation Eveready)’에 관한 내용은 제법 알려져 있다. 1953년 휴전을 앞두고 미 육군이 세운 작전의 명칭이다. 한국의 이승만 대통령을 하야(下野)시켜 휴전의 걸림돌을 제거한다는 내용이었다. ‘한국군 단독 북진’까지 주장하며 미군이 주도하는 휴전에 반대 입장을 거듭 표명하는 이승만 대통령과 미 행정부의 이해관계가 충돌하면서 미 군부가 마련한 비상 계획의 하나였다. 그런 미 군부의 숙고(熟考)가 거듭 이어지는 가운데 돌출한 것이 대한민국 육군참모총장 백선엽의 방미였다.)

Why did the US military choose such a specific timing to push for Paik Sun-yup's visit to the US? Even now, a clear answer to this question remains elusive. (미군은 하필이면 왜 그런 시점을 택해 백선엽의 방미를 추진했던 것일까. 아직까지는 시원한 답을 찾아볼 수 없는 문제이기도 하다.)

In any case, Paik Sun-yup, who set out for the US under these circumstances, first arrived in Tokyo via a US military transport plane. There, he boarded a civilian propeller aircraft of Pan American Airways and crossed the Pacific over two days. After arriving in San Francisco, he traveled by military transport from Travis Air Force Base to Washington, D.C. On his first day, he attended a welcoming party hosted by US Army Chief of Staff General Lawton Collins. (아무튼 그런 상황에서 방미 길에 오른 백선엽은 우선 미군 수송기 편으로 도쿄에 도착한 뒤 그곳에서 민항기인 미 팬암 항공사 프로펠러기에 올라탄 뒤 이틀에 걸쳐 태평양을 건넜다. 샌프란시스코에 도착한 뒤 그는 다시 트레비스 공군기지에서 군 수송기 편으로 워싱턴에 도착했다. 우선 도착 첫날 로튼 콜린스 미 육군참모총장의 환영 파티에 참석했다.)

At the party, he was able to meet his old comrades-in-arms. Paik Sun-yup often recalled that the most memorable among them was Colonel Hazellet. He had been an advisor who offered much advice and counsel when Paik's 1st Division was advancing toward Pyongyang. (그 파티에서는 옛 전우(戰友)들을 만날 수 있었다. 그중 가장 기억에 남는 인물은 헤이즐레트 대령이었다고 백선엽은 자주 회고했다. 그는 백선엽의 1사단이 평양을 향해 진격할 때 여러 충고와 진언을 아끼지 않던 고문관이었다.)

Eventually, his old comrades reportedly followed him to his hotel, where they chatted late into the night over beer and such. Colonel Hazellet, who now wore the rank of colonel, noticed Paik's trousers lying crumpled in the hotel room and took them home, saying, "I'll have these ironed for you by tomorrow morning." The next day, he returned the trousers and remarked, "My wife and I had a hard time ironing them all night." (결국 옛 전우들은 백선엽이 묵던 호텔까지 따라와 맥주 등을 곁들이며 밤늦게까지 환담을 나눴다고 한다. 어느덧 대령 계급장을 달고 있던 헤이즐레트는 백선엽의 호텔 방에 있던 그의 바지가 많이 구겨진 모습을 보자 “내일 아침에 이 바지들을 다림질해 오겠다”며 집에 들고 갔다고 한다. 이튿날 그는 바지들을 가져온 뒤 “아내와 함께 밤새 다림질하느라 애를 먹었다”고 했다.)

However, it was a different person who gave Paik Sun-yup something to think about. It was Arleigh Burke, who visited his hotel room late at night after all the other comrades had left. He too was a comrade who, when Paik led the 1st Corps in Gangwon Province, commanded the 5th Cruiser Division and supported Paik's 1st Corps in their northward operations. Arleigh Burke, who later rose directly from Rear Admiral to Admiral and served as Chief of Naval Operations, was then the Director of the Strategic Plans Division at the Navy Department. (그러나 백선엽에게 뭔가를 일깨운 사람은 따로 있었다. 먼저 호텔 방에 들어 있던 전우들이 모두 돌아간 뒤 밤늦게 찾아온 알레이 버크였다. 그 또한 백선엽이 강원도에서 1군단을 이끌던 무렵 동해 5순양함대를 이끌며 백선엽 1군단의 북상 작전을 도운 전우였다. 후에 소장에서 대장으로 곧장 진급해 미 해군 참모총장을 역임하는 알레이 버크는 당시 해군본부 전략작전국장을 맡고 있었다.)

Burke was later appointed by US President Eisenhower and served as Chief of Naval Operations for six years, earning reverence as a 'naval legend.' The two were close comrades; whenever Burke visited Seoul, he and his wife would stay at Paik Sun-yup's residence. Arriving late at night, he knocked on the door of Paik's hotel room and stayed for a long while. After talking until dawn, Arleigh Burke reportedly made a certain remark. (버크는 후일 아이젠하워 미 대통령에게 발탁돼 해군 참모총장을 6년간 역임하면서 ‘해군의 전설’로 추앙을 받았던 인물이다. 버크는 서울을 방문할 때면 부부가 함께 백선엽의 자택에서 묵고 갈 정도로 둘은 친밀한 전우 관계였다. 밤늦게 찾아와 백선엽의 호텔 방문을 두드린 그는 한참을 머물다 갔다. 새벽까지 많은 이야기를 나누다가 알레이 버크는 문득 이런 말을 했다고 한다.)

In response to Paik's question, "So what should I do?", Arleigh Burke said, "You need to see President Eisenhower before you return and mention this point." It was a meeting with the US President that wasn't on the schedule. Thinking that even a request was worth making from South Korea's standpoint, Paik Sun-yup moved promptly the next morning. (“그럼 내가 뭘 해야 하느냐”는 백선엽의 물음에 알레이 버크는 “귀국하기 전 아이젠하워 대통령을 꼭 만나서 이 점을 언급할 필요가 있다”고 했다. 일정에도 없는 미 대통령 면담이었다. 한국의 입장에서는 요청이라도 한 번 해야 하겠다는 생각에 백선엽은 이튿날 아침 곧장 움직였다.)

He first went to see US Army Chief of Staff Lawton Collins. When Paik said, "I must meet President Eisenhower before I leave," Collins reportedly looked incredulous. However, as Paik Sun-yup argued forcefully, stating, "As the Army Chief of Staff of South Korea, whose forces fight alongside the US military on the front lines where numerous casualties occur daily, I have that right," Collins eventually summoned Deputy Chief of Staff John Hull from the next room. He then said, "Arrange for General Paik Sun-yup to meet President Eisenhower." (그는 우선 로튼 콜린스 미 육군참모총장을 찾아갔다. “아이젠하워 대통령을 만나고 가야겠다”는 말에 콜린스는 어이가 없다는 표정을 지었다고 한다. 그러나 “수많은 사상자가 매일 생겨나는 전선에서 미군과 함께 싸우고 있는 한국군의 육군참모총장은 그럴 권리가 있다”며 백선엽이 강력한 주장을 펼치자 마침내 콜린스는 옆방에 있던 존 헐 참모차장을 호출했다. 그는 이어 “백선엽 장군이 아이젠하워 대통령을 만날 수 있도록 주선을 하라”고 말했다.)

The next day, contact came from the White House. He headed to the White House as arranged by the US Army headquarters. It was his first time there. Paik Sun-yup recalled it was May 13. He entered through the 'public door' used by regular White House staff. Accompanying him were a male captain serving as an interpreter who was in the US at the time, and Lieutenant Colonel Hausman, a US intelligence officer who had been spectacularly active in Korea as an intelligence specialist. (이튿날 백악관에서 연락이 왔다. 그는 미 육군본부의 주선에 따라 백악관을 향했다고 한다. 처음 가보는 곳이었다. 5월 13일이었다고 백선엽은 기억했다. 백악관에서 일하는 일반 직원들이 다니는 ‘통용문’으로 우선 들어갔다. 당시 미국에 와 있던 통역 담당 남성인 대위, 정보통으로 한국을 무대로 화려한 활약을 펼쳤던 미 정보장교 하우스만 중령이 수행했다.)

However, the captain and Lieutenant Colonel Hausman were stopped after entering through the public door, just before the Oval Office where the meeting was to take place. One can only speculate that there was an instruction to "let only Chief of Staff Paik in, excluding his aides." When Paik entered the Oval Office alone, Eisenhower greeted him warmly. Eisenhower, who had made an unofficial visit to South Korea in December 1952 as President-elect, clearly remembered Paik Sun-yup, who had briefed him on the plan to strengthen the South Korean military's capabilities. <<>> (그러나 남성인 대위와 하우스만 중령은 통용문으로 들어선 뒤 면담 장소인 백악관 오벌룸 앞에서 제지를 당했다. “수행원을 제외하고 백선엽 총장만 들이라”는 지시가 있었던 것으로 추측만 할 수 있는 장면이었다. 백선엽 총장이 혼자 오벌 룸에 들어서자 아이젠하워는 반갑게 맞아줬다. 1952년 12월 미 대통령 당선자 신분으로 비공식 방한했던 아이젠하워는 그의 앞에서 한국군 전력 증강 계획을 브리핑했던 백선엽을 또렷이 기억하고 있었다.)

item.title: President Lee Holds Summit in Chile… Strengthening Cooperation on Key Minerals: Copper and Lithium (李대통령, 칠레서 정상회담… 구리·리튬 핵심 광물 협력 강화)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, held a summit with Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast on the 30th (local time), agreeing to strengthen cooperation, stating that the two countries are ideal partners in building a supply chain for key minerals. Chile is the world's largest producer of copper, essential for semiconductor manufacturing, and holds the world's largest reserves of lithium, used in the battery industry. ()

Following the talks at the presidential palace in Santiago, the capital of Chile, President Lee and President Kast signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on mineral resources partnership. The agreement includes elevating and regularizing the bilateral "Mineral Resources Partnership Joint Committee" to the ministerial level, and pursuing full-cycle cooperation from mining to processing and manufacturing of key minerals such as lithium and copper. The presidential office stated, "This enhances the stability of Chile's mineral supply, currently worth $2.1 billion annually (approximately 3 trillion won), and establishes an institutional foundation to support the entry of our companies into the local market." (칠레를 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 30일(현지 시각) 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고 양국이 핵심 광물 공급망 구축의 이상적 파트너라며 협력 강화에 뜻을 모았다. 칠레는 반도체 생산에 필수인 구리 생산량 세계 1위, 배터리 산업에 쓰이는 리튬은 매장량이 세계 1위다.)

Three additional MOUs were signed to promote bilateral investment and cooperation in security and maritime safety. The existing MOU on polar research cooperation was expanded to cover areas such as the environment, ecosystems, and Antarctic governance. Chile serves as the gateway to the King Sejong Antarctic Science Station. The two sides also agreed to lay the institutional groundwork for deepening cooperation in the defense and shipbuilding industries. (이 대통령은 이날 칠레 수도 산티아고의 대통령궁에서 카스트 대통령과 회담 뒤 광물자원 파트너십 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다. 양국 간 ‘광물자원 파트너십 공동위’를 장관급으로 격상·정례화하고, 리튬과 구리 등 주요 광물의 채굴부터 가공, 제조까지 전(全) 주기 협력에 나선다는 내용이다. 청와대 측은 “현재 연 21억달러(약 3조원) 규모의 칠레 광물 수급 안정성을 제고하고 우리 기업의 현지 진출을 지원하는 제도적 기반을 구축한 것”이라고 했다.)

The two leaders decided to reactivate the "Korea-Chile FTA Free Trade Committee" after a decade, accelerating the "modernization" of the Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The Korea-Chile FTA, the first FTA signed by Korea with a foreign country, came into effect in 2004. Over 20 years have passed, raising the need to reflect changes in economic and trade conditions. In an interview with the Spanish-language news agency EFE prior to his visit to Chile, President Lee stated, "Today's economy is being reshaped around digital trade, artificial intelligence (AI), clean technologies, resilient supply chains, and the transition to carbon neutrality. The FTA must evolve to reflect these new realities." (양국 간 투자를 촉진하고, 치안과 해양 안전 분야에서 협력하는 내용의 MOU 3건도 체결했다. 기존의 극지 연구 협력 MOU는 환경, 생태계, 남극 거버넌스 분야로 협력 범위를 넓혔다. 칠레는 남극 세종과학기지의 출입 관문이다. 방산과 조선 분야 협력 심화를 위한 제도적 기반 마련에도 나서기로 했다.)

At a dinner meeting with compatriots the previous day, President Lee noted that Chile was the first country in Latin America to officially recognize the government of the Republic of Korea in 1949, saying, "Although it is one of the farthest countries, we are connected by deep friendship." On the afternoon of the 30th, President Lee is scheduled to attend a business roundtable event with business leaders from Korea and Chile, after which he will depart for Argentina, the final stop of his South American tour. (양국 정상은 ‘한·칠레 FTA 자유무역위원회’를 10년 만에 재가동해 FTA의 ‘현대화’ 작업도 본격 속도를 내기로 했다. 한·칠레 FTA는 외국과 맺은 첫 FTA로 지난 2004년 발효 뒤 20년이 넘으면서 경제·통상 여건이 달라진 부분을 반영해야 한다는 필요성이 제기돼 왔다. 이 대통령은 칠레 방문에 앞서 가진 스페인어권 통신사 EFE(에페)와 인터뷰에서 “오늘날 경제는 디지털 무역, 인공지능(AI), 청정 기술, 회복력 있는 공급망, 탄소 중립 전환을 중심으로 재편되고 있다”며 “FTA가 이러한 새로운 현실을 반영하도록 진화해야 한다”고 말했다.)
